scripts.start:api: sh -c 'set -a && . ./.env && set +a && dotnet run --launch-profile https --project apps/api/src/Claims.Api'
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint:repo && npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: dotnet format Claims.slnx analyzers --verify-no-changes --no-restore && dotnet format Claims.slnx style --verify-no-changes --no-restore
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:repo && npm run lint:fix:web && npm run lint:fix:api
scripts.lint:fix:api: dotnet format Claims.slnx analyzers --no-restore && dotnet format Claims.slnx style --no-restore
scripts.format: npm run format:repo && npm run format:web && npm run format:api
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:repo && npm run format:check:web && npm run format:check:api
scripts.check:repo: npm run lint:repo && npm run format:check:repo
scripts.check:api: npm run lint:api && npm run format:check:api && npm run test:api && npm run build:api
scripts.check: npm run check:repo && npm run check:web && npm run check:api
